dict.string: AMS Access requires camera access for identity verification and proctoring during exam sessions.
AMS Access requires microphone access for proctoring during exam sessions.
macOS shows Wi-Fi network names only to apps with Location access. AMS Access uses it only to list Wi-Fi networks near you; your location is never recorded or sent.
